note: 番坊 (美术规划 §1 番坊: 海蓝灰、盐白、胡商的红黄): a wind-scoured coast — stunted pines leaning inland, salt-burnt shrubs and thorn scrub, grey-green turf with sea-pinks and white thrift, a few broad shade trees (榕) and fan palms in the port's lanes where southern ships put in. The region's default flora; a map's own `flora` overrides it key by key.
